name: example-mapping
description: Run an example-mapping session (Matt Wynne) for story refinement. Produces structured output with four card types — yellow (story), blue (rules / acceptance criteria), green (concrete examples), red (questions / unknowns). Session outputs: story ready-or-not verdict, open questions, shared understanding artifact. Facilitates 25-30 min workshops before dev. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
